title: Google Research SMART Eval: Sentence-Level Soft-LCS & Source-Augmented Summary Evaluation
author: repo-triad-forge

edges.description: Subproject smart_eval in snapshot google-research-master (archive snapshot, non-git); arXiv:2208.01030
Complements LLM trace selection with fine-grained sentence-level Soft-LCS candidate quality evaluation
Relevant to semantic quality evaluation and uncertainty-aware response scoring in Brain Harness

claims.assertion: SmartScorer computes sentence-level SMART-1 (unigram max-match), zero-padded SMART-2 (sentence bigram average), and dynamic-programming SMART-L via _soft_lcs (L148-L178) over live or precomputed matrices, combining source and reference scores via max(ref_smart[x], src_smart[x]) and raising ValueError if reverse matrices are omitted when is_symmetric_matching=False.

MatchingFunction abstracts pluggable pairwise sentence matchers (RougeMatchingFunction, MeteorMatchingFunction, ChrfMatchingFunction, BleuMatchingFunction, BleurtMatchingFunction) supporting single-pair and batched list calls.
AggregateFunction decouples sentence score reduction across MinAggregateFunction, MaxAggregateFunction, MeanAggregateFunction, and WeightedMeanAggregateFunction.

distilled_learning: Evaluate long-form summaries at sentence granularity using soft pairwise matchers, dynamic-programming Soft-LCS ordering, precomputed model-matcher matrices, and max(reference, source) aggregation while explicitly guarding asymmetric matching matrices.
